claims.text: Available labels for antisocial events in datasets include personal attacks, harassment, hate speech, and general toxicity.
The 'Conversations Gone Awry' dataset labels conversations as containing personal attacks or remaining civil throughout.
Another dataset labels conversations based on whether a comment was removed by a moderator for rudeness or hostility.
